title: Fix macOS startup and Wi-Fi AP configuration errors
author: herasymchyk-oleksii
body:
## Summary

- Skip the old updater when no update URL is configured, avoiding a startup failure on the packaged macOS app.
- Contain Google Translate initialization failures so its `Performance.measure` exception does not close the app.
- Write Wi-Fi AP settings to `02-start-wifiAP/wifiAP.config` after the recovery files finish copying. The previous literal `*-start-wifiAP` path caused `ENOENT`.

## Verification

- Built the macOS x64 app from the v2.8.6 source and verified its DMG checksum and app signature.
- Confirmed the packaged app contains the Wi-Fi AP fix.
- Ran a temporary-directory test that copies the recovery files and writes `wifiAP.config` to the expected directory.
- Ran `node --check` and `git diff --check`.

No vehicle installation was tested.
